text:
Type: three-seat sofa with wide arms
Use: seating, lounging, napping; living room, family room
Style: contemporary, minimalist, Scandinavian
Materials: woven fabric upholstery, soft deep cushions
Colors: light warm grey, pale greige
Shape: low wide frame, broad box arms, two deep seat cushions, two loose back cushions, hidden feet, long and bulky
Feel: calm, relaxed, roomy, soft
Goes with: white walls, light wood, wool throws, black accents; Scandinavian, minimalist or modern living rooms

product.name: KIVIK
product.description: KIVIK is a generous seating series with a soft, deep seat and comfortable support for your back.
